description: abm-in-visum provides activity-based travel-demand algorithms and scripts running within PTV Visum. The provider is SchweizerischeBundesbahnen (repository owner). Geographical and temporal coverage: The collaborative SBB and PTV project produces daily person-level mobility schedules and includes user model contributions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0 for repository code; PTV Visum separately licensed. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Free repository code does not provide a free PTV Visum installation. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-ptv-visum, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
